targets.old_statement: A load sticking out more than five feet past the rear needs a red flag or cloth at least 16 inches square by day and a red light at night.
targets.old_spoken_statement: A load sticking out more than five feet past the rear needs a red flag or cloth at least sixteen inches square by day and a red light at night.
targets.statement: A load extending more than five feet past the rear must carry a red flag or cloth at least sixteen inches square during the day and a red light from one-half hour after sunset until one-half hour before sunrise.

targets.old_statement: When towing another vehicle, the towline must keep the vehicles within 15 feet of each other, and both need lights on at night.
targets.old_spoken_statement: When towing another vehicle, the towline must keep the vehicles within fifteen feet of each other, and both need lights on at night.
targets.statement: When towing another vehicle, the towline must keep the two vehicles within fifteen feet of one another, and both vehicles must display lights from one-half hour after sunset until one-half hour before sunrise.
